**Live (160 ms chunk, +LM): 32.7× real time, 5.54% WER (selection panel) · Final (commit pass at utterance ends): 16.8×, 5.00% WER**

![Isosyll: Always Listening, Barely Computing. Single-core throughput and pooled WER on the 730-utterance LibriSpeech DEV selection panel, with paired WER gaps, active-core joules per audio-second, and v3.2.0 opt-in --rms-norm summary](docs/paper/money.png)

**Figure 1.** Isosyll v3.1.0 live (160 ms, +LM; identical weights in v3.2.0): 32.7×, 5.54% WER on the selection panel (+0.81 pp on unselected DEV) vs. Zipformer INT8 14.0×, 5.25%; final 5.00%, 16.8×. [Paper](docs/paper/paper.pdf) · [v3.2.0 record](docs/ultra/releases/v3.2.0.md) · [v3.1.0 record](docs/ultra/releases/v3.1.0.md).

- **Always-on.** 32.67× vs. 14.04× real time for Zipformer INT8 (2.33× paired), at 57.3% of its active-core J/audio-s and 109.47 MB (72% of its memory); greedy: 2.46×, 56%, 49%. WER gap to Zipformer: +0.28 [−0.02, +0.58] pp on the selection panel, +0.81 [+0.62, +1.02] pp on the unselected C half.
- **Final text.** 5.00% WER from the same weights against Zipformer's 5.25% (paired bounds include 0 on the selection panel and on the unselected C half), at 1.19× its speed and 115% of its energy; opt-in v3.2.0 `--rms-norm` (Z1) recovers −0.94 pp at −30 dB synthetic attenuation on the C half (native 0 dB: −0.02 pp, within noise), and −3.36 pp at −30 dB synthetic attenuation on S-half automatic-endpoint chapter streams, at ≤ +0.21% engine / ≤ +0.31% stream CPU (H0).
- **Bit-exact and portable.** 18 witness runs on other x86 and ARM CPUs reproduce all 730 transcripts (three SIMD backends, v3.1.0); four-backend scalar parity holds on main from b6a924e8 (not for the v3.1.0 binary; 0/50 committed-text diffs across AVX2/scalar/NEON on the f04027c builds, where flag-on has 5/50 full-tuple diffs vs. the independent oracle and 0 committed-text diffs).

The single-core rows above are v3.1.0 measurements (identical RC2 INT8 weights, LMs, and default decoder path in v3.2.0; opt-in Z1 `--rms-norm` is off by default). Released by owner decision after missing the registered gates (5540 vs. 5489 full-DEV final edits; 800 vs. 722 live and 722 vs. 650 final panel edits); live +LM scores 6.10% on full DEV (descriptive: it contains the selection half) and +0.81 [+0.62, +1.02] pp against Zipformer on the unselected C half. LibriSpeech DEV only, exploratory. Δ is ours minus Zipformer's, one-sided 95% bounds; ratios in parentheses are medians of within-block ratios to Zipformer timed in the same blocks.
